tokens.description: The page. Told apart by nothing, because it is the ground.
tokens.name: --helix-color-background

tokens.description: A plane on the page: a card, or a panel you own. Told apart by a fill, an edge or a lift, whichever the policy leads with.
tokens.name: --helix-color-surface

tokens.description: Lifted while still lying on the page: a selected tab, a hovered row. Told apart by its fill, which goes down the ramp rather than up.
tokens.name: --helix-color-surface-raised

tokens.description: Over the page rather than on it: a menu, a popover, a dialog. Told apart by its shadow and by what it covers.
tokens.name: --helix-color-surface-overlay

tokens.description: A well a value goes into: an input, a track, a groove. Told apart by its fill, inward.
tokens.name: --helix-color-surface-sunken
